title: UI bundles
description: The UI bundles the owner supplied in the design packages directory (<work>/spec-<slug>.bundles.json): cdsbundles.list_bundles' result, written by the step `cdsbundles.list_bundles` (orchestrator/flows/spec_authoring.py) and validated against this file. The ui-design-source-selector is handed it as `ui bundles`; an empty `bundles` means every UI item is designed with CDS.

packagesDir.description: The design packages directory, or null when the dispatch names none.

shell.description: The shell the bundle names, or null.

superseded.description: Bundles a newer bundle of the same artifact replaces.

ignored.description: Entries of the directory that are not bundles.
